title: Sagrada Família Outside Tour
text: This was an amazing tour, that provided history of Antoni Gaudi’s creative and inspiring vision for the Sagrada Família. His intent of creating a church for the people of Barcelona, that would be funded by the citizens and not the government.
author: Charles_D

title: Many aspects of a fantastic city
text: Anastasiia your guide is not only very informative and knowledgable about many things about Barcelona her enthusiasm just rubs off onto those taking the tour.
author: Kevin_B

title: Francisco was a great guide!
text: Francisco was a fantastic guide. His knowledge of the Sagrada Familia and city building and their history was impressive. He was very attentive and accommodating. I highly recommend this tour and Francisco if you want to learn about these fascinating landscapes in Barcelona
author: Enrique_O

title: Fantastic
text: The points to visit were well chosen, wasting little time with travel and more with the presentation of the details of each of the places. The tasting is well worth it. Francisco is an excellent guide and demonstrates in-depth knowledge about the places. Repeat!
author: Pedro_S

title: Educational And Entertaining
text: The tour with Francisco was very nice and we learned so much from him. He had extensive knowledge of the Sagrada Familia and Gaudí. He provided an entertaining guided tour without boring the participants, occasionally asking questions to keep everyone engaged. Thank you!
author: Onur_A

title: Awesome tour with Francisco
text: Francisco was an excellent tour guide and we had an awesome 2.5hrs learning a lot about Sagrada Família and other Gaudi buildings!
author: Mark_K

title: Francisco was the best tour guide I have experienced
text: Francisco as an amazing tour guide. Incredibly knowledgeable, friendly, funny and personable. I would highly recommend a tour with Francisco.
author: Nadine_R

title: Gaudí and Barcelona in a nutshell!
text: The tour provides a great overview of three beautiful buildings by Gaudí (Sagrada Família, Casa Milà, and Casa Batlló) and additional information about the architectural development of Barcelona. The tasting of local sweets (in a shop in Casa Milà) is a nice change of pace on the tour, especially for children, without taking up too much time. The tour also ends right at Plaça de Catalunya, from where you can easily continue your day on foot or by subway. Our guide Mirto explained everything in a great and understandable way for the children (7 and 9 years old) and included them in the tour.
author: Carolin_B

title: Great tour guide
text:
Anastasia was very pleasant, very knowledgable and easy to approach and understand her explanations on the tour

Her vocal and physical hand descriptions, pointing out specific items on the church and around the town were excellent and easy to follow

Would definitely recommend
author: Johnnyfieldy

title: Fantastic tour and fabulous Francisco
text: Francisco was an excellent choice with his depth knowledge about the city and it's monumental structures. Helpful, courteous and humorous, we enjoyed his company.
author: Sabkaa_M
